name: Mena Mani Industries Limited
about: Mena Mani Industries Limited engages in the trading of biofuels in India. It is involved in construction and other information technological activities. The company was formerly known as Anar Industries Limited and changed its name to Mena Mani Industries Limited in May 2018. Mena Mani Industries Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
